_library_note: The team's library of past grant applications (chunks made by the team's uploader). Read only: the Judge never writes there. Override with LIBRARY_DB / LIBRARY_COLLECTION.
_note: Never put a password here. For a database password, set the MONGO_URL environment variable instead; it overrides mongo_url.
_models_note: A model starting with 'claude' runs through your Claude login (claude auth login). Any other name runs locally in Ollama. Local models used before: qwen2.5:7b (database: qwen2.5-coder:7b).
reply_style: REPLY STYLE (every reply): short, friendly and easy to scan. Never long or alarming.
Start with ONE line that answers the question, beginning with one emoji: ✅ ready / OK, ❌ not ready / a problem, ⚠️ needs attention, 💰 budget, 📅 dates, 📝 writing, 💬 general.
Then at most 5 bullets ('- '), one short line each, most important first. Use **bold** only for a key word or amount.
Keep the whole reply under about 120 words. No headings, no tables, no long quotes, no lists of every rule.
End with one short line: the single most important next step, or 'Ask me for details on any of these.'
If the user asks for a specific format or length (e.g. 'in 5 sentences', 'full detail'), follow that instead.
